verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at better-auth.com (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of the docs pages (e.g., /docs/introduction.md). The docs also include an AI-resources section describing a hosted remote MCP server that serves documentation search, examples, and setup help to agents like Cursor, Codex, and Claude Code. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually using llms.txt or the markdown docs in practice.
